briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch accelerates AGI timeline amid escalating US-China compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race toward AGI with o4, Claude 4.5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro all showing emergent capabilities. Funding remains robust while safety concerns mount over uncontrolled deployment.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with 2.1T parameters; Anthropic's Claude 4.5 achieved 94% on GPQA; Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B; xAI and DeepSeek both dropped new reasoning models this week.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA shipped 1.2M Blackwell GPUs in Q2; Microsoft and Google announced new 100k H100 clusters; TSMC reports 3nm yield issues slowing next-gen training runs.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will any lab achieve 95% on the full ARC-AGI benchmark before 2027?
